name: Guide
description:
While traveling in natural areas, once per day, choose two effects, which are available to you for that day:

  • Navigator: You always know which direction is North.

  • Skulk: You and your companions' Stealth checks get +2d.

  • Scout: You and your companions cannot be surprised in combat.

  • Expert: Once per rest, when a companion would fail a skill check, you may choose to have them re-roll.

  • Tracker: You automatically notice any tracks left by creatures who have passed through the area within the past 3 days. You learn the approximate size and number of the creatures.

  • Forager: You can increase the Keeping of the Quest for one rest per day.
